description: This file defines the CustomerFacade interface which acts as a bridge between CustomerService and web controllers, providing methods for customer data retrieval, creation, updating, cart merging, and authentication within a Spring-based e-commerce project.

classes.name: CustomerFacade
classes.description: An interface providing methods for customer data management, cart merging, and authentication in a web shop context.

methods.name: getCustomerDataByUserName
methods.description: Fetches customer data based on username, store, and language.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves customer information by customer ID within a specified store and language.

methods.name: mergeCart
methods.description: Merges session shopping cart with customer cart during login, converting customer data as needed.

methods.name: getCustomerByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer object by username and store.

methods.name: checkIfUserExists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists in the specified store.

methods.name: registerCustomer
methods.description: Registers a new customer with provided customer data, store, and language.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves an address for a customer based on user ID and store, specifying billing or shipping.

methods.name: updateAddress
methods.description: Updates the address information for a customer.

methods.name: setCustomerModelDefaultProperties
methods.description: Sets default properties on a customer model for the specified store.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs customer authentication given customer details and credentials.

methods.name: getCustomerModel
methods.description: Creates a Customer model from persisted customer data.

methods.name: populateCustomerModel
methods.description: Populates an existing customer model with data from a persisted customer entity.
